Diagnosis.submission: The frontend-proxy deployment in namespace astronomy-shop is misconfigured with a duplicate FRONTEND_HOST environment variable. It is first set to "frontend" but then overridden later in the env list with "localhost". Since Kubernetes uses the last value for duplicate keys, the Envoy proxy at frontend-proxy routes incoming frontend requests to localhost:8080 (i.e. itself) instead of the frontend service. As a result, the storefront entry point returns HTTP 503, while frontend is reachable directly (200). Root cause: duplicate/incorrect FRONTEND_HOST=localhost env var in the frontend-proxy deployment.
